topics.angle: Written in Arabic first for a Moroccan who hears these words for the first time in a group briefing: the terms specific to the Hajj that the Omra glossary does not carry — the three forms of pilgrimage, the talbiyah, the standing, the two tawafs that are not the arrival tawaf, the days of tashriq, the sacrifice, the delegation of the stoning. Each entry gives the word, what it names, and where it falls in the days, with the fiqh differences signalled and referred to a scholar.
topics.delta: The glossary page defines the Omra's vocabulary, which the Hajj shares only in part. This post adds the Hajj-only terms — tamattu', qiran, ifrad, wuquf, ifada, tashriq, hady, tawkil — and places each in the sequence of the days, then links the glossary as the shared base.
